raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the ATP profile by conflating Jorge Lozano’s doubles career-high (No. 4) with his singles career-high. The ATP page shown by WebSurfer clearly displayed “Singles … Career High Rank: 51 (1988.09.12),” but the Planner read it as No. 4 and then concluded Lozano had the better singles ranking. This overrode earlier correct information (Lozano singles No. 51) and led to the wrong final answer (the correct comparison is Vinci No. 7 vs. Lozano No. 51, so Vinci is better).
